CustomObject.description: Who receives a Custom Email Alert and / or a Custom Teams Message: one record per recipient (an address, a queue, a public group, a field of the record, or an Apex resolver), in To, Cc or Bcc for the email, with an optional formula Condition on the record. A record linked to both an alert and a Teams message serves both. Read by EmailService (and TeamsMessageService through it) when a request is built.
CustomObject.label: Custom Email Recipient
